info.title: Waaru Developer API
info.description: Source contract for this release; deployment requires release verification. Keys remain number-bound. Explicit workspace:* scopes cover all workspace contacts/static segments. All operations except instance discovery require a connected EXTERNAL_API number. Management and discovery scopes require an explicit grant; existing keys do not gain them. Unknown input fields are rejected. Canonical phone validation, custom-field catalog policies, template freshness/quality and messaging rules are runtime constraints in addition to the schema.

get.description: Requires instance:read. Available even when the bound number is disconnected or not in EXTERNAL_API mode. apiAvailable reports connection and handler mode only, never permission to send. No credentials, provider identifiers or diagnostics are returned.

default.description: 400 invalid input;401 missing/revoked key;403 insufficient scope;404 inaccessible resource;409 policy/revision conflict;422 unavailable Form or invalid launch inputs;429 safety limit;502 template provider unavailable;5xx temporary failure. Error responses contain public codes and fixed safe messages, never internal diagnostics. Honor Retry-After. Retry sends only with the same persisted idempotency key.

post.description: Requires workspace:labels:manage. Body limit: 4096 bytes. Requires an explicitly granted management scope. Archive preserves historical assignments and membership, reserves the name, and rejects active or pinned dynamic-segment dependencies. Repeat archive is safe; creation has no idempotency key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist one unique value per logical send. Same normalized recipient and content repeats acceptance; changed request returns409. Scope is workspace and number, including after key rotation.

parameters.name: X-Waaru-Require-Authentication
parameters.description: Set to true to require an AUTHENTICATION template before persistence. This stricter mode is part of idempotency identity; use the same header when replaying a request.

name.description: After NFKC normalization, trimming and whitespace collapsing, the name must contain 1 to 48 characters. The 48-character maximum does not apply to the raw input. The request body limit is 4096 bytes.

callbackUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL, port 443, no credentials/query/fragment. Required for creation. DNS validation is enforced.
